# Omar Nassar — AI Engineer & Full Stack Developer

> Senior AI Engineer based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Building enterprise-ready AI solutions, multi-agent systems, and RAG architectures that scale. Founder of Virelio, an AI agency delivering custom AI agent teams for businesses.

## About

Omar Nassar is a Senior AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 7+ years of experience building production AI systems. He specializes in multi-agent architectures, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms, and enterprise AI deployments. Omar is the founder of Virelio, an Amsterdam-based AI agency that builds custom AI agent teams — delivering working agents in 2 weeks.

Key metrics: EUR 50K monthly business impact, 30+ systems built, 200+ automations deployed.

## Featured Projects

### Enterprise AI Platform
First fully private, on-premise AI platform serving 80,000+ employees. Multi-agent LLM architecture with local 70B Llama models via Ollama and Qdrant for vector storage. Achieves <2s inference on standard hardware. Zero data leaves the premises.

### WhatsApp AI Business Agent
Intelligent WhatsApp business assistant handling customer inquiries, appointment booking, and lead capture 24/7. Integrates with WhatsApp Business API. Processes natural language in Dutch and English with persistent conversation context.

### Slouch — AI Posture Coach
AI-powered posture detection web app running 100% client-side using MediaPipe Pose. Real-time webcam analysis detects slouching through torso metrics. Zero data leaves the device. Available at https://slouch.pro

### Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Base Platform
Comprehensive RAG platform indexing millions of proprietary documents. 95% retrieval accuracy, sub-second response times, 10+ internal data source integrations. Built with Llama 3, Qdrant, FastAPI, and LangChain.

### Invoice Fraud Prevention Platform
Fraud prevention ecosystem that reduced payment defaults by 73%, improved cash flow by 45%. Processes 50k+ monthly transactions with AI-powered risk scoring. Recovered EUR 2M+ in outstanding payments.

### AI Customer Support (virelio.ai)
AI-powered customer support system with ElevenLabs speech synthesis, n8n workflow automation, and OpenAI for conversation processing. 24/7 availability for meeting management and client inquiries.

### Full-Stack Multi-Agent System
Autonomous agent system with 6 specialized agents (research, code, review). Reduced project execution time by 80% through parallelized workflows. Built with CrewAI and LangGraph.

### Medical Technical File Builder
AI platform accelerating medical device technical dossier creation 5x. Uses NLP and regulatory compliance algorithms for FDA, CE marking, and ISO standards.

Virelio is an Amsterdam-based AI agency founded by Omar Nassar. The agency builds custom AI agent teams for businesses with a focus on rapid delivery (most agents live in 2 weeks).
